missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Инженер' is an animate masculine noun in the nominative as the predicate noun. 'Опытный' is the agreeing masculine adjective. A natural way to state a profession.

Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Инженера' takes the genitive-like accusative because the noun is animate masculine. 'Хорошего' agrees in the animate accusative. A clear example of the animacy rule.

Strategic focus: Genitive possessor. 'Инженера' is the masculine genitive after 'у', marking the possessor. 'Этого' agrees in the genitive, and 'опыта' is genitive after 'нет'. A natural possession frame.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Инженеру' is the dative form, the recipient of the call. 'Молодому' agrees in the masculine dative. A clean dative-of-recipient example.

Strategic focus: Instrumental predicate. 'Инженером' is the instrumental used after 'стала' to mark a change of role. 'Известным' agrees in the masculine instrumental. A core instrumental-of-profession model.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Инженере' is the prepositional form after 'об', the topic of discussion. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional. A reliable prepositional model.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Инженер' is the nominative subject of 'проверил'. 'Чертежи' is the accusative plural object, and 'все' agrees. A natural workplace sentence.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Инженеры' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Опытные' agrees in the plural, and 'на заводе' is prepositional. A clean plural statement.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Инженеров' takes the genitive-like accusative plural because the noun is animate. 'Новых' agrees, and 'наняла' is the verb. A core animacy-plural example.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Инженеров' is the genitive plural after 'много', here homophonous with the animate accusative. 'Молодых' agrees, and 'в отделе' is prepositional. A core quantity pattern.
